page.layout: One column of running text, with the paragraphs set full width. Below the text, one italic closing line. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: solum temeratores alienarum nuptiarum gladio pu-
nit, sed & eos, qui cum masculis nefandam libidin-
em exercere audent.§.4.inst.eod.
Item Lex Cornelia de sicariis, quae homicidas ul-
tore ferro persequitur, vel eos, qui hominis occiden-
di causa cum telo ambulant.§.5.inst. eod.
Lex Pompeja de parricidiis, qua cautum est, ut par-
ricida neque gladio, neque ignibus, neque ulli alij solen-
ni[?] poenae subjiciatur, sed insutus culeo cum cane, &
gallo gallinaceo, & vipera, & simia, & inter eas fera-
es angustias comprehensus (secundum quod regio-
nis qualitas tulerit) vel in vicinum mare, vel in am-
nem projiciatur: ut omnium elementorum usu vi-
vus carere incipiat, & ei coelum superstiti, & terra
mortuo auferatur.§.6.inst.eod.& l.unica, C.de his
qui parentes vel liberos occiderunt.
Lex Cornelia de falsis, quae etiam testamentaria
vocatur, poenam irrogat ei, qui testamentum falsum
scripserit, signaverit, recitaverit, subjecerit: vel signū
adulterinum fecerit, sculpserit, expresserit sciens do-
lo malo.§.7.inst.eod.
Lex Julia de vi publica seu privata adversus eos
exoritur, qui vim vel armatam, vel sine armis com-
miserint.§.8.inst.eod.
Lex Julia peculatus eos punit, qui publicam pecu-
niam, vel rem sacram, vel religiosam furati fuerint.
§.9.inst.eod.
Lex Flavia de plagiariis, quae interdum capitis poe-
nam ex sacris Constitutionibus irrogat, interdum
leviorem.§.10.inst.eod.
Sunt praeterea publica judicia, Lex Julia de ambi-
tu, Lex Julia repetundarum, & Lex Julia de Annona,
& Lex Julia de residuis.§.11.inst.eod.

page.notes: Printed page with running head DE RUDIMENTIS and page number 582. A stray mark at the top left and the stains at top right are not printed text and are left out. The word "solenni" is partly obscured at the line end and is uncertain. The hyphenation in "par-ricida", "pu-nit" and "ul-tore" is partly unclear at the line ends. "alij" is copied as printed. Long s is written as s throughout, and f in the scan is read as long s. The catchword DE is at the lower right.
